title: Exploring the Plausibility of Hate and Counter Speech Detectors with Explainable AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating explainable AI (XAI) methods for hate speech and counter-speech detection using transformer models (BERT). Although it deals with hate speech, which is a moral/ethical issue, and utilizes a dataset titled 'Thou Shalt Not Hate', the core of the research is a technical evaluation of explainability techniques rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religion, faith, or ethics.
